H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H7141: Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H650: properly, containing, i.e. a tube; also a bed or valley of astream; also a strong thing or a hero
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H4970: properly, extent (of time); but used only adverbially (especially with other particle prefixes), when (either relative or interrogative)
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H8210: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H5519: properly, a thicket of men, i.e. a crowd
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H7440: properly, a creaking (or shrill sound), i.e. shout (of joy or grief)
H8426: properly, an extension of the hand, i.e. (by implication) avowal, or (usually) adoration; specifically, a choir of worshippers
H1995: a noise, tumult, crowd; also disquietude, wealth
H2287: properly, to move in acircle, i.e. (specifically) to march in asacred procession, to observe afestival; by implication, to be giddy
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H7817: to sink or depress (reflexive or causative)
H1993: to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor
H3176: to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H3444: something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3383: Jarden, the principal river of Palestine
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H8415: an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply)
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H1530: something rolled, i.e. a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins), by analogy, a spring of water (plural waves)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H5553: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively (a fortress)
H7911: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention
H6937: to be ashy, i.e. darkcolored; by implication, to mourn (in sackcloth or sordid garments)
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H6106: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
H2778: to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter
H6887: to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive
